#### <u>Bi-Weekly Report</u>

- **Booming dry bulk market defies red flag warnings emerging from the steel complex -** Once again, the Capesize sector is leading the dry bulk rally although Panamax rates have also experienced a very strong performance with spot rates now hovering close to the 20,000-mark for the first time since December. Both the **Pacific and Atlantic markets** remain **well supported**, each for different reasons, and **any indication of softening is perceived as an opportunity** to either take-in tonnage (for the physical market) or add to long positions (for the freight futures market).
